pr_title: Fix intermittent crash in settings reload
pr_body:
## Summary of the Pull Request

I can't reliably get the original crash to repro unfortunately. When it did crash, this was the line of code that the debugger would open on. It was crashing trying to `memcpy` some garbage out of `value`, in the case where `value` is empty. 

So I'm guessing that the fix it to _not_ try and make a `wstring` from garbage, and instead construct it from the empty string. Again, I can't repro consistently, so this is a spitball. But the code _looks_ wrong.

## References
* #8565 

## PR Checklist
* [x] Closes #8723
* [x] I work here
* [ ] Tests added/passed
pr_comments: Okay I'm just gonna close this for now. No one else hit this, and the code looks like it's not even right. Maybe in the future we'll have a better idea of what happened (and a real fix).

issue_context.title: Crash in `DxEngine::SetPixelShaderPath`
comments: @DHowett @carlos-zamora Hey heads up, this is going to make the settings UI bug bash really painful. 😬
Hmm. Can it be worked around by setting a shader path (even the None shader?) if so, let’s detail that as an unblocking workaround.

By any chance, did you change `retroTerminalEffects`? Pankaj reported a crash related to changing `retroTerminalEffects` in the settings file a while back, but very recently (like last week), I wasn't able to repro it.

Horrifyingly, I'm having a hard time reproing here. It hit the first time I tried saving the settings this morning, but hasn't hit again since. I'm building a fresh dev build off main to see if that one'll hit it.

You know, there _is_ something here.

```
E:\BA\203\s\src\renderer\dx\DxRenderer.cpp(983)\TerminalControl.dll!00007FFF131F97B2:
(caller: 00007FFF131ED9C7) LogHr(35) tid(1ae8) 8007000E Not enough memory resources
are available to complete this operation.
    Msg:[std::exception: bad allocation] 
```
It's only fair that I trade you a cookie for a cookie. I accept the assignment ;P
Hey uh, there are _a lot_ of crashes in this bucket. We should probably service this -.-

:tada:This issue was addressed in #9092, which has now been successfully released as `Windows Terminal Preview v1.6.10412.0`.:tada:

review_comments: i don't totally get it. a wstring_view that is `.empty()` _is_ `""`.
Oh. Yikes. When it was broken in the debugger, it looked like the string was full of random memory. I guess I assumed that the view was empty, but secretly actually filled with garbage.
